title: The Orchard Climb
description: A pure vertical ladder from the orchard floor to the high overlook: 96-pixel riser posts over bramble beds, switchback retaining walls that nearly touch the sky, and falling fruit to read on the way. Expert redesign: suspended fruit weights and orchard lifts.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute day
identity.visual_source: Original generated pixel-art plate with native animated scenery

rooms.name: The orchard floor
rooms.lesson: Climb the fallen-fruit ladder — every rise is a full jump. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The fruit-tree terraces
rooms.lesson: Rise between the planted terraces; mind the falling fruit. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: Among the high branches
rooms.lesson: Switchback up the high branches as fruit drops past. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The retaining walls
rooms.lesson: Scale the retaining wall to the sky, then thread the drop ledges. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The high orchard overlook
rooms.lesson: Crouch-run the pruned corridor, then drop to the overlook. Follow the weight as it swings away.
